mainEntity.name: What should I do first if the flooring in a foreclosed house is wrecked?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the foreclosed property has damaged, missing, or stained flooring, the first step is a full walk-through to identify what can be repaired and what needs replacement. In Denver-area homes, moisture, pet damage, and long vacancy often affect subfloors too, so a contractor should check beneath the visible surface before quoting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with a full flooring inspection, including the subfloor. In foreclosed homes, visible damage often hides moisture or structural issues that affect the final scope and price.
